name: Cleaving Finish
benefit:
If you make a melee attack, and your target drops to 0 or fewer hit points as a result of your attack, you can make another melee attack using your highest base attack bonus against another opponent within reach. You can make only one extra attack per round with this feat.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 115
After making a Cleaving Finish attack, if you bring another target below 0 hit points in the same round, you can spend 5 stamina points to make another Cleaving Finish attack.
flavor: When you strike down an opponent, you can continue your swing into another target.
